parameters.description:
Send a notification to your own Pushover destination by posting a simple `msg` request to the UnitySVC gateway.

`msg-to-pushover` accepts an HTTP POST carrying the unified `msg` envelope (`title`, `body`, `type`, `format`). The gateway composes an Apprise `pover://` URL from the credentials in your stored secrets and delivers the notification via apprise.unitysvc.dev, so you run no messaging infrastructure of your own.

Two channels are available: the free `apprise` channel uses your own stored credentials; the `apprise-plus` channel binds extra per-enrollment destinations via enrollment parameters (`user_key_secret`, `token_secret`).

token_secret.description: Name of the customer secret holding this enrollment's Pushover token

user_key_secret.description: Name of the customer secret holding this enrollment's Pushover user key
